t: So? You watched it. Tell me you liked it.
Really? Why do you say that?
Um, let me think. It is two hours long, and you know the ending after ten minutes. That is why.
OK, but the two of them feel like real people. That is the whole point.
I mean, the photography is beautiful. I will give you that.
So it is not that bad.
It is not bad. It is just slow. What about you? Why do you love it so much?
That is a good question. Because nothing happens, I think. And nothing happening is fine sometimes.
